result:
I graded quiz 0001 for submission s1 and wrote the grades to `grades/0001-s1.json`. You got 2 items right, 2 partly right and 2 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Feedback |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | Correct | The loop of choosing an action, running it and feeding the result back is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | Wrong (M4) | The model doesn't open the booking system. It writes a request naming `check_calendar` with its arguments, and the program runs the tool. |
| q3 | Correct | A step limit is the right safeguard against an agent stuck repeating the same failed edit. |
| q4 | Wrong (M4) | The answer is 4, not 1. The model never runs tools. Three tool requests take 3 calls and the final answer takes a 4th. |
| q5 | Partial | Sending the result back to the model is right, but you left out why. The model needs it to choose its next step or write the answer. |
| q6 | Partial (M3) | Choosing a tool from its name and description is right. The model has no automatic memory across sessions, so it doesn't remember earlier tool choices. |

**What to work on:** the model only writes text, such as a tool request. The program around it runs the tool and sends the result back. Any memory across sessions has to be built into the program. That matters for your assistant's training-status memory.

**Next step:** trace the laser-cutter request on paper as a table with the columns "model outputs", "program does" and "model receives". Then recount the model calls. Your retake, `submissions/s2.json`, is still ungraded and will show whether this has stuck.

I also added learning record 0003 and updated `NOTES.md`. Do you want me to grade s2 next?
